column1: # Refusal mutants of Goal.inflate_refusal and Goal.deflate_refusal (public-stream-refusal): each turns a
# function's Z_STREAM_ERROR for a NULL or inconsistent stream into Z_OK. Structural rows: no loop body,
# no arithmetic. Run in the mutant shards with the other safety lists (scripts/verification.py).

column3: if (← inflateStateCheck strm) != 0 then return (Z_STREAM_ERROR, dictLength)
column4: if (← inflateStateCheck strm) != 0 then return (Z_OK, dictLength)

column3:
-- if (inflateStateCheck(strm)) return Z_STREAM_ERROR;
  if (← inflateStateCheck strm) != 0 then return Z_STREAM_ERROR
  let z ← ldZStream strm
  let state ← castInflateState z.state
  let mut windowBits
column4:
-- if (inflateStateCheck(strm)) return Z_STREAM_ERROR;
  if (← inflateStateCheck strm) != 0 then return Z_OK
  let z ← ldZStream strm
  let state ← castInflateState z.state
  let mut windowBits

column3: if (← deflateStateCheck strm) != 0 then return Z_STREAM_ERROR\n  let s ← castDeflateState (← zrd strm (·.state))\n  -- if (level == Z_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION)
column4: if (← deflateStateCheck strm) != 0 then return Z_OK\n  let s ← castDeflateState (← zrd strm (·.state))\n  -- if (level == Z_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION)

column3: if (← deflateStateCheck strm) != 0 || dictionary == .null then return Z_STREAM_ERROR
column4: if (← deflateStateCheck strm) != 0 || dictionary == .null then return Z_OK

column3: if (← deflateStateCheck source) != 0 then\n    zwr dest (fun z => { z with state := none })\n    return Z_STREAM_ERROR
column4: if (← deflateStateCheck source) != 0 then\n    zwr dest (fun z => { z with state := none })\n    return Z_OK
